name: Instruction chips arrive, then get struck through
looks: Small coloured pill chips, each a short instruction ("make it pop", "but keep it minimal"), drop in one at a time under a header reading like an incoming request. A beat later, a couple of the chips get a diagonal strike-through and go dim, as if being crossed off a list in real time, while the rest stay bright.
build: Chips are rounded-rect pills in a wrap layout, each with its own flat colour; they pop in with a small overshoot, staggered 120-180ms apart. The strike-through is a single diagonal line drawing across the retired chip (`strokeDashoffset`, 150ms) immediately followed by its opacity dropping to 40%.
sound: A light pop per chip arriving, a sharper zip sound on each strike-through.
prompt: Drop in a row of small coloured instruction chips one at a time under a header, then strike a diagonal line through a couple of them and dim them, as if the list is being edited live while the rest stay bright and active.
